ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The square is circumscribed to the circle. Find the exact circumference of the circle.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a square, and inside the square there is a circle; the circle is tangent to the four sides of the square; the length labeled below the bottom side of the square is 25 mm. Then reason: A square circumscribed to the circle means the circle is the inscribed circle of the square, so the diameter of the circle equals the side length of the square. The side length of the square is 25 mm, so the diameter of the circle d = 25 mm. The formula for the circumference of a circle is C = πd, therefore C = 25π mm.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：图中是一个正方形，圆内切于正方形的四边，底部标注正方形边长为 25 mm。再看文字：题目要求求圆的精确周长。利用几何关系：内切圆的直径等于正方形边长，所以圆的直径是 25 mm。用周长公式 C = πd，得到 C = 25π mm。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有一个正方形，正方形内有一个圆，圆与正方形的四条边相切；正方形底边下方标注的长度是 25 mm。再推理：正方形 circumscribed to the circle 表示圆是正方形的内切圆，因此圆的直径等于正方形的边长。正方形边长为 25 mm，所以圆的直径 d = 25 mm。圆的周长公式为 C = πd，因此 C = 25π mm。
